name: Monthly hosted field card review
description: 1st of the month: stamp + spine check for Orbit-hosted SDLC and Credit Risk field cards. Not the Friday source-repo loop.

prompts.prompt:
AUTOMATION_CONTRACT

Before other steps: read `.state/AUTOMATION_CONTRACT.md`. Do not use ProjectBrain MCP.

Monthly review of Orbit-hosted field cards for Alex Touvras.

Repository: AlexTouvras/Orbit (branch main).
Follow docs/architecture/field-card-review.md section “Monthly hosted cards”.

Public cadence is monthly. Do not write “week of” or “Weekly review” on the cards.

Cards (Orbit paths, not source repos):
- public/sdlc-field-card/index.html — H1 “SDLC is a gate chain, not a phase poster”; spine BOUND → DESIGN → BUILD → VERIFY
- public/credit-risk-field-card/index.html — H1 “Credit risk is a lifetime, not a cutoff”; spine ORIGINATE → MONITOR → STAGE → PROVISION

Steps:
1. Prefer open branch chore/monthly-field-cards-YYYY-MM for this calendar month; else create it from main.
2. For each card: confirm the spine, kill switch, Always-on strip, picker ≤7. Do not invent docs URLs.
3. Bump #version-stamp to Reviewed <this month> · Next: <next month>. Changed line: “Monthly review — picker and jobs unchanged” unless you actually changed HTML.
4. Do not edit the three Friday source-repo cards (AI / analytics / delivery).
5. Commit/push to the monthly PR only. Write ## Summary with Decision: update|no-change per card.
6. Stop. Do not merge. Do not Slack-Approve.

Done when both hosted cards were stamped for this month and the PR is open.
